about_short_description.short_description: Confident AI offers open-source unit testing solutions for applications utilizing large language models (LLMs).

product.name: DeepEval LLM Evaluation Platform
product.description: An open-source platform for benchmarking, testing, and improving large language model applications using metrics and tracing.

product.name: DeepEval Metrics Suite
product.description: A collection of over 30 metrics to evaluate LLM outputs based on task-specific criteria.

product.name: Dataset Editor and Management Tools
product.description: Tools to curate, pull, and push evaluation datasets for LLM testing and benchmarking.

product.name: Prompt Management and Interpolation
product.description: A system to manage, version, and interpolate prompts for use in LLM evaluations.

product.name: Tracing and Observability Tools
product.description: Instrumentation tools to trace LLM application executions and observe detailed evaluation metrics.

product.name: Enterprise Deployment and Compliance Services
product.description: Options for secure, compliant deployment of Confident AI solutions with data residency, access control, and on-premises hosting.
